description: NEGATIVE fixture (Batch A / A5) — bundle.default with NO `federation_register`. Federation admission is a MANDATORY required property (docs/required-properties.json, id `federation-admission`), so a bundle that supplies no register MUST report the declared LINT-TRUST-06 [GAP] and exit 3 (INCOMPLETE) rather than [OK]: the verifier states that it could not establish admission instead of passing over it. Asserted by tests/test_federation_gate.py and NEVER run in the green path.
